validates: assets, trust boundaries, attack paths and invariants
typical_evidence: diagram export, model version, assumptions, review notes
notes: Requires owner validation and scope reconciliation.

validates: unit tests, invariant tests, fork simulation and transaction interaction
typical_evidence: test output, seed, fork block, trace, state diff
notes: Use isolated forks or testnets unless production activity is separately authorized.

validates: known code patterns, authorization defects, upgrade risks and contract structure
typical_evidence: detector output, source version, compiler version, triage notes
notes: Static findings require reachability and impact validation.

validates: property violations, invariant failures and state-machine edge cases
typical_evidence: configuration, seed, minimized case, replay steps, coverage
notes: Record preconditions and avoid real assets.

validates: transaction effects, state diffs, gas behavior, event paths and monitoring conditions
typical_evidence: simulation URL or export, block, chain ID, trace, state diff
notes: Commercial or hosted tooling must respect data-handling restrictions.

validates: source patterns, dangerous APIs, secret-handling patterns and policy rules
typical_evidence: rule version, scan output, source commit, triage notes
notes: False positives and custom rule semantics must be documented.

validates: data flow, taint flow, injection paths and code security properties
typical_evidence: database version, query pack, scan output, source commit
notes: Findings need reachable-path and authorization review.

validates: web/API exposure, input handling, sessions and common application flaws
typical_evidence: scan policy, request log, response evidence, target version
notes: Throttle traffic and stay within approved rate and endpoint scope.

validates: authentication, authorization, business logic and manual exploit validation
typical_evidence: proxy history, repeater evidence, screenshots, reviewer notes
notes: Only interact with authorized targets and accepted risk conditions.

validates: known vulnerable dependencies and advisory mapping
typical_evidence: lockfile, scan output, advisory, affected version
notes: Vulnerability presence is not the same as exploitability.

validates: component inventory, package metadata and artifact transparency
typical_evidence: SBOM, build hash, source commit, package lock
notes: Pair with advisory and provenance review.

validates: container packages, IaC findings, misconfiguration and secret exposure
typical_evidence: image digest, IaC path, scan output, exception record
notes: Confirm runtime exposure before assigning risk.

validates: cloud and IaC policy, network exposure and identity control gaps
typical_evidence: policy output, Terraform plan, resource IDs, triage notes
notes: Read-only collection is preferred unless change control is approved.

validates: cloud account posture, identity, logging, encryption and compliance checks
typical_evidence: account scope, finding export, evidence snapshot, remediation record
notes: Use least-privilege read-only credentials where possible.

validates: portable detection logic and telemetry coverage
typical_evidence: rule version, query translation, test alert, tuning notes
notes: Use safe signal emulation and preserve false-positive rationale.

validates: telemetry availability, alerting, SLOs and recovery signals
typical_evidence: dashboard, query, alert event, timeline, incident ticket
notes: Monitoring evidence must include time window and environment.

validates: algorithm correctness, approved-mode assumptions, test vectors and validation status
typical_evidence: test vector output, validation listing, algorithm configuration, implementation version
notes: Formal validation claims require verified certificate scope and operating environment.

validates: key policy, signer authority, HSM/KMS controls, audit logs and root-key protection
typical_evidence: key policy export, access log, signer set, ceremony record, approval workflow
notes: Never request private keys

validates: contract tests, simulated networks, forked execution, traces and deployment workflows
typical_evidence: test output, network configuration, fork block, traces, source commit
notes: Keep fork and simulated-network activity separate from production authority.

validates: symbolic-execution findings, bytecode paths and vulnerability hypotheses
typical_evidence: tool version, bytecode/source commit, finding output, triage notes
notes: Symbolic findings still require reachability and impact validation.

validates: symbolic test assertions, counterexamples and invariant reasoning
typical_evidence: test suite, counterexample, solver configuration, replay notes
notes: Record solver limits and reproduce counterexamples where possible.

validates: coverage-guided fuzzing, invariant violations and state-machine failures
typical_evidence: configuration, seed, coverage, minimized case, replay steps
notes: Run only against isolated lab
